name: green-light-red-jersey-singer
image_purpose: Concert social content and live-performance editorial visual

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic live concert portrait of an approved adult female performer commanding an indoor arena stage under green lighting.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult female stage performer with dark shoulder-length hair slightly messy under a black baseball cap, focused intense expression, and athletic presence. She wears the reference's oversized red American-football-style jersey with white number 26, secure opaque red athletic shorts, black knee pads with visible reference logos, black mid-calf socks, and black high-top sneakers. She holds a black wireless microphone.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body vertical composition from an extreme low 24mm worm's-eye angle. Power stance with feet planted, torso slightly leaning back, microphone near mouth, right hand raised near forehead. Include large stage platform, blurred audience, metal crowd barriers, haze, and bright rear lights.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong green stage lighting from below, bright white backlights, subtle rim light, dramatic upward shadows, concert haze, energetic audience, and high-contrast live-performance atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 24mm-equivalent wide-angle lens, full-body vertical frame, sharp performer with slight audience blur, realistic fabric and skin texture, high dynamic range, subtle concert grain, photorealistic 8K look.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An ultra-realistic full-body vertical concert photograph of one approved adult female stage performer with dark shoulder-length hair slightly messy under a black baseball cap, focused intense expression, and athletic presence. She wears the reference's oversized red American-football-style jersey with white number 26, secure opaque red athletic shorts, black knee pads with the visible reference logos, black mid-calf socks, and black high-top sneakers, holding a black wireless microphone. Extreme low 24mm worm's-eye angle, power stance, torso slightly leaning back, microphone near mouth, one hand raised near forehead, large indoor stage, blurred audience, metal crowd barriers, concert haze, strong green under-light, bright white backlights, subtle rim light, dramatic upward shadows, realistic fabric and skin texture, high dynamic range, photorealistic 8K live-performance energy.
